articles.title: Why a new SEC plan could ease a legal headache for tokenized securities
articles.snippet: The SEC's new proposal to overhaul transfer-agent rules could eliminate duplicate offchain shareholder records, reducing reconciliation costs and legal uncertainty for tokenized securities.

articles.title: Europe’s top regulator questions Polymarket and Kalshi’s EU access, warns of authorization gaps
articles.snippet: ESMA said that event contracts may fall under existing EU binary-options bans, crypto-asset frameworks like MiCA or national gambling laws.

articles.title: Polymarket names former Amazon finance chief Warren Jenson as its first CFO
articles.snippet: Jenson becomes the prediction market’s first CFO as Polymarket builds its regulated U.S. exchange and global platform.

articles.title: Bitcoin Bancorp snaps up thousands of defunct Bitcoin Depot ATMs for $620,000
articles.snippet: Just over a quarter of Bitcoin Depot’s more than 9,200 kiosks have been sold for less than $1 million, court records show.

articles.title: MoneyGram unveils stablecoin-backed card as digital dollars move into everyday spending
articles.snippet: The remittance giant is rolling out a Visa card that lets customers hold dollars and spend from a stablecoin-backed balance.
